item: Row 55: five tests that failed by neighbour, machine or load, fixed at the cause
summary: (1) The pooled-connection probe test compared two fresh connections after an earlier test's engine.dispose(), so its precondition guard tripped; it now writes through one connection before comparing. (2) The rollup-serve fixture cleared the serve singleton but not the decline record, so a real build an earlier test kicked could decline on live memory and suppress the next test's build kick for 30 s; the record is cleared with the rest. (3) The auto-mode test depended on the machine's RAM tier (off by default below the floor, S1.1); it pins a machine above the floor, and a new test pins the one below it. (4) The MemAvailable test and (5) two qualification-pass tests read the live cgroup and machine memory, so a loaded runner (604 MiB available) changed the answer; each pins the reading its subject does not cover. Every fix was reproduced red first. No assertion loosened, nothing skipped or retried.
